lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular spots arranged in semi-vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Specific nodes are visible in a roughly 4x3 grid pattern within the primary field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with primary circular blobs, creating a grid-like structure along the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a light-colored apex and a shadowed ventral margin.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of significantly smaller, less-ordered spots on the pectoral fin surface and head region.
